title: Set up Eidolon
body: Four short steps: your keys, who you'll talk to, her voice, and memory.
keys.title: Your API keys
keys.body: Eidolon talks to three paid services with your own keys: Soniox hears you, OpenRouter thinks and Fish Audio speaks. Each needs credit on its account.
keys.note: Keys stay on this machine, readable only by you.
keys.otherProvidersBody: Embeddings, reranking and transcript refinement use your OpenRouter key unless you give them a key and an API base of their own.
keys.providerSettingsBody: The API base each service sends to, and the embedding model.
keys.missing: Add all three keys to continue.
keys.checksFailed: Not every key passed its check
keys.checksFailedBody: Calls fail with a key the provider refuses. Fix the keys marked above, or continue and fix them later in Settings.
persona.title: Who will you talk to?
persona.body: Start with the demo persona, or create your own and build her up later in the studio.
persona.viewerNameHelp: She uses it in calls. Leave it empty and she won't use a name.
persona.demoBody: A Chinese VTuber who runs a little flower shop with her cat. She comes with her prompt and outfits, ready to call.
persona.createBody: Starts with a Chinese prompt skeleton in her name. Add facts, videos and outfits in the studio.
persona.mandarin: Personas speak Mandarin, and the videos you build one from should be Mandarin streams.
persona.name: Her name
persona.name.help: In her own language; prompts use it as written.
persona.id.help: Names her folder: lowercase letters, digits, - and _. It can't change later.
persona.id.reserved: Eidolon uses that word itself. Pick another id.
persona.shortName.help: What prompts shorten her name to, and her avatar's letters. Empty uses her name.
persona.summary.help: Who she is, in one English sentence. It tells the knowledge search which questions are about her.
persona.summary.placeholder: e.g. A Chinese VTuber who streams on Bilibili and loves cats
persona.timezone.help: Her clock, for the date and time she knows. Starts as yours.
avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.help: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image, up to {max}. Without one, her avatar shows her initials.
avatar.badType: Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
avatar.failed: {name} was created, but her avatar didn't upload. Add it in her studio.
voice.title: Pick a voice
voice.body: Search Fish Audio's public voices and play their samples.
voice.stepBody: How {name} sounds. Search Fish Audio's public voices and play a sample before you pick one.
voice.inherited: {name} inherits {env} from the environment. Continue to keep it, or pick a voice of her own: it applies to her alone.
voice.searchPlaceholder: A name or a style, e.g. 温柔
voice.mandarin: She speaks Mandarin, so the search starts among Chinese voices.
memory.title: Memory (optional)
memory.body: With memory on, she remembers you from one call to the next. It needs Qdrant, a database you run in Docker on this machine. Skip it and everything else still works.
memory.docker: Install Docker Desktop, or Docker Engine on Linux, and start it.
memory.run: Run this once in a terminal:
memory.runNote: It answers only on this machine, keeps its data in a Docker volume and restarts with Docker.
memory.checkHint: Check it below. Already running Qdrant here? Just check its address.
done.title: You're all set
done.body: Your keys, persona and voice are saved.
done.studio: Give her facts, videos and outfits in the studio, so she knows who she is.
newPersona.title: New persona
newPersona.body: She starts with a Chinese prompt skeleton in her name; build her up in the studio.
